    Is aviator a scrabble word?
    AI Overview

    AI Mode replied:

    AVIATOR is a valid 7-letter Scrabble word worth 10 points in standard US Scrabble (TWL/NASPA) (or 16 points in some UK/SOWPODS or variant scoring systems depending on the platform). 
    Scrabble Tile Breakdown for AVIATOR (10 Points)
    • A (1 point) × 3
    • V (4 points) × 1
    • I (1 point) × 1
    • T (1 point) × 1
    • O (1 point) × 1
    • R
      (1 point) × 1
       
    Top Sub-Words You Can Make From AVIATOR
    You can use these smaller words if you cannot play the full 7-letter word: 
    • 6-letter words: VIATOR (9 pts)
    • 5-letter words: AORTA, ATRIA, RAITA, RATIO, RIATA, TIARA, VARIA (5–8 pts)
    • 4-letter words: AIRT, ARIA, ARVO, IOTA, RIOT, ROTA, TARO, VITA (4–7 pts)
    • 3-letter words: AIR, ART, AVA, OAR, OVA, ROT, TAR, VAR, VIA (3–6 pts) 
    Check letter combinations or verify more plays using the Scrabble Merriam-Webster Finder or Word Unscrambler.
